title: Google’s Custom AI Chips: Can On-Premises Power Solve Your Agentic Bottlenecks?
description:
Google is moving its custom AI chips into your own data center, but does that actually solve the security and speed issues of running autonomous agents? We’re breaking down the infrastructure shift, the market reaction to Nvidia’s leadership probe, and what Zoom’s new AI features mean for your next meeting.

What we covered:
• Google says TPUs are now used for agentic workloads, cloud customers and on-prem deployment
• Nvidia shares slide after internal probe into reports of foreign-intelligence targeting of Jensen Huang
• Zoom says it is adding more AI context and proactive assistance to workplace tools

Three distinct AI stories, with lively debate, useful discoveries and practical takeaways.

Listener question: When your workplace tools add 'proactive' AI features, do you find them helpful or just another layer of distraction?

What to watch tomorrow: not which AI headline was loudest, but which one quietly changed the rules.

Alex, Jamie and Rufus tell you what changed in AI, who wins, and what you do next.

What changed. Who wins. What you do next.
